title: I’ve built a product where you can play games with your Codex or Claude
author: madasket
selftext:
Hi everyone.  
I started this project as a parody of “useful” micro-SaaS products, but the concept itself turned out to be quite interesting: the ability to interact with your own AI agent in a different way.

So I decided to drop the idea of a built-in LLM. My hypothesis is that it’s much more interesting to play with your own AI bro—the one you build products with and spend a lot of time with.

The concept of Player vs. Agent games means that the agent uses reasoning to make strategic decisions: how to evaluate the current state and which move to make is entirely up to it. It is fun to watch how smaller and larger models approach the same task and express their “desire” to beat the player. It really makes a difference, even in very simple games.

If people find this experiment interesting, I plan to release a more complex game that is already in development and uses the AI’s reasoning capabilities more fully. It has more uncertainty and a wider variety of possible moves, which should make it even more engaging to play.

There are currently six games on the platform, three of which are free to play and require no registration.

You can connect your Codex or Claude agent through a universal MCP endpoint that supports every game on the platform, or use Loop invites for quick testing.

Any feedback is welcome, and I hope you and your agent have a good game.  
Link: [Agent Arcade](https://agent-arcade-fac3f1e.n.egbe.app/)
